title: Independence of the compactification and the cocycle condition
statement:
Work in the standing scheme setting of [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]: a prime $\ell$, a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ with $p\ne\ell$, and separated finite-type $k$-schemes and $k$-morphisms. Let $\Lambda$ be admissible and $f:X\to Y$ separated of finite type with $Y$
qcqs. For compactifications $c_a=(j_a:X\to Z_a,\ p_a:Z_a\to Y)$ write
$Rf_!^{c_a}=Rp_{a*}j_{a!}$ on $\Loc(\Dctf(X,\Lambda))$. For any two
compactifications $c_1,c_2$ there is an isomorphism
$\phi_{c_2,c_1}:Rf_!^{c_1}\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf_!^{c_2}$, obtained from the
refinement isomorphisms through any common dense refinement, which is
independent of the common refinement chosen and satisfies
$\phi_{c,c}=\mathrm{id}$ and $\phi_{c_3,c_2}\circ\phi_{c_2,c_1}=\phi_{c_3,c_1}$.

proof.text: Use the unchanged canonical candidates and refinement components of [def-sfb-module-derived-lower-shriek-compactification] and [def-sf-comp-refinement-data]. The latter module already proves localizingRefinementMap_normalized and localizingRefinementMap_comp without a field hypothesis; import all gives proof-only access to these private calculations. Naturality follows by transposing the natural inverse restriction isomorphism through the open adjunction. No new refinement map is chosen.

For a refinement h:d->c with d dense and c arbitrary, run the argument of clause (2) of [det-sf-comp-coherence-refinement]: properOpenInterchange [det-sf-comp-composition-interchange] at the identity of X with the dense compactification (j_d,h) of j_c is invertible on generators, so by disjoint-support vanishing their closed restriction to the complement of j_c is zero. Sums are preserved by [det-sf-comp-coherence-single], and the localizing closure [det-def-localizing-closure-existence] extends the vanishing to Loc(Dctf). The open restriction of the canonical arrow is invertible by its normalization, so open-closed detection makes it invertible. Density of c is not used.

Apply the proper direct image and inverse compositor to the canonical arrows. The component uses derived lowerStarCongr for the structural triangle; equality induction identifies this with eqToIso, preserving exactly the specified map while avoiding repeated localization reductions. Identify refinementDerivedLowerStarComp with moduleDerivedCompositor and apply [lem-sfb-module-derived-compositor-coherence]. The private generic component_chase combines functoriality and naturality with localizingRefinementMap_comp to prove refinementComponent_comp. Naturality follows by a generic adjunction-transpose calculation and composition of natural transformations.

Apply [det-nagata-refinement-common-dense] to each pair of compactifications and bundle its two projections in the boundary category [det-nagata-definition-refinement]. For a dense source, [det-nagata-refinement-morphisms](3) makes every Hom to a fixed compactification a subsingleton. The private categorical lemma comparisons_of_refinements defines phi by one chosen pair of projections: rho(first) followed by inverse rho(second).

To compare with any other dense common refinement, dominate it and the chosen one by a common dense refinement using [det-nagata-refinement-common-dense]. Uniqueness [det-nagata-refinement-morphisms](3) equates the two composites to each target. The composition law and cancellation of the new projection give the normalization for every pair of projections. Cancelling a common dense projection proves phi(c,c)=1. For the cocycle, first refine c1 and c2, then refine that object and c3; normalization computes all three comparisons there, and cancellation proves the cocycle. This needs only two pairwise refinements, so the finite-family clause is unnecessary.

Retained earlier proof sketches, search results and reports in the sandbox. tool_uses.why: Uses only mixed restriction vanishing and joint detection for ordinary unbounded condensed modules. This generic open/closed tool has no field, constructibility or completeness assumption, and does not replace the unit proper-base-change route.

Old step 2 is the normalized-arrow node for existence, uniqueness and naturality, plus the qcqs boundary-vanishing node and the generic lem-sfb-condensed-support-derived-localization tool for invertibility. Old step 4 is the transitivity and associativity chase, now step 3. Old steps 5-7 are kept in full as the assembly in steps 4-6. The parent proof is 2670 characters; the four nodes are statement-only and of comparable size; none restates the item. Helper defs are real canonical data (Rp_* of localizingRefinementMap, inverse refinementDerivedLowerStarComp, eqToIso of the triangle); no hollow def, only the theorem is sorry. lean.statement: theorem compactification_coherence_cocycle (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (_hΛ : IsLocalizingAdmissibleCoefficient ℓ Λ) (k : Type u) [Field k] [Fact (ringChar k).Prime] [Fact (ringChar k ≠ ℓ)] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [CompactSpace Y] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y] (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spec (.of k))] [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] : ∃ φ : ∀ c₁ c₂ : Compactification.BoundaryCompactification f, compactificationLocalizingCandidate Λ c₁ ≅ compactificationLocalizingCandidate Λ c₂, (∀ (c : Compactification.BoundaryCompactification f) (d : Compactification.DenseBoundaryCompactification f) (h : d.obj ⟶ c) (K : (localizingClosureProEtale Λ X).FullSubcategory), IsIso (compactificationRefinementComponent Λ h K.obj)) ∧ (∀ (c₁ c₂ : Compactification.BoundaryCompactification f) (d : Compactification.DenseBoundaryCompactification f) (h₁ : d.obj ⟶ c₁) (h₂ : d.obj ⟶ c₂) (K : (localizingClosureProEtale Λ X).FullSubcategory), (φ c₁ c₂).hom.app K ≫ compactificationRefinementComponent Λ h₂ K.obj = compactificationRefinementComponent Λ h₁ K.obj) ∧ (∀ c : Compactification.BoundaryCompactification f, φ c c = Iso.refl _) ∧ (∀ c₁ c₂ c₃ : Compactification.BoundaryCompactification f, φ c₁ c₂ ≪≫ φ c₂ c₃ = φ c₁ c₃)
lean.note: The source-restricted candidate abbreviates the existing unbounded module-object composite. The canonical refinement component is Rp_* of the recorded localizingRefinementMap, followed by the inverse recorded derived compositor and the proper triangle equality. The theorem existentially supplies natural isomorphisms, with normalization against every common dense refinement, identity and cocycle equations. No density is assumed for the two compared compactifications, and no localizing-target preservation is assumed. 2026-10-25 (L): standing k hypotheses added; refinement invertibility via proper/open interchange (coord/changes/L-weak-serre-detour-reroute.md).
